Title: Concise outcome-focused title
Environment: URL or app build; browser/device; network condition
Preconditions: Required account state, feature flag, test data, and network condition
Actual Result: Describe the incorrect observable outcome, including safe exact error text.
Business Impact: Identify affected users, blocked task, and the financial, compliance, trust, or operational impact that supports the severity.
Product Defect Qualification: Requirement source; independent reproduction; why non-product causes are excluded
Automated Test Name: pytest test name or manual test ID
Device or Browser: Browser and version or device model
Related Work Items: BUG-000 or external work item ID
AI Assistance Disclosure: Tool/model; task; sanitized prompt reference; human validation; issues found
